id: title:haacked:keep sub second precision in the person deletion cutoff

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the retention and deletion workflow for archived or deleted records, specifically enabling mutable ORM instances and microsecond-precision timestamp storage required for accurate deletion eligibility checks.
review.reason: The change makes the PendingDeletesTable mutable, which is a prerequisite for the DAG workflow that updates and inserts rows. It also upgrades timestamp precision to DateTime64(6, 'UTC'), supporting the requirement to distinguish events within the same second for deletion eligibility. Tests verify this sub-second precision preservation. This represents a substantive, bounded change
review.uncertainty: While the code changes support the deletion workflow, the complete implementation and broader system-wide impact are not fully demonstrated; the benefit is inferred from the dependency rather than observed end-to-end behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No untrusted instructions. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds frozen=False to PendingDeletesTable dataclass, allowing mutable instances.
